### Prayer’s First Priority
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/prayers-first-priority
Passage: Matthew 6:9
Points:
- The opening petition of the Lord’s Prayer is a request rather than an exclamation of praise.
- Jesus directs believers to ask God to cause His own name to be honored and revered everywhere.
- Praying this does not persuade a reluctant God, whose highest priority is already the honor of His name.
- Prayer serves to reshape our personal priorities so that they match God’s great purposes.
- Believers pray with great power when their hearts align with God’s passion for His own glory.

### Trusting God for Daily Provision
Author: Ashley Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/daily-provision-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 6:11
Points:
- Financial and resource uncertainties frequently tempt believers to worry and withhold generosity.
- Praying for daily bread reminds Christians that God faithfully supplies what is needed day by day.
- Trusting God for present provision produces a heart overflowing with gratitude for what is already given.
- Confidence in God’s daily care frees believers to share generously with others in need.
- Relinquishing anxiety over future needs allows believers to depend peacefully on their heavenly Father.
